_about: Tracker for the Sage X3 screens guide (Debbie, Claire, Sam). James sends screenshots from the training site (sdi-displays-trn, folder X3ERPV12 / SDIMIG) 5 at a time. Edit this file, then run build_guide.py to rebuild the Word guide. Status: todo / selection (selection screen only) / done (selection + results) / not-this (wrong screen) / not-found.

seen_on_screens.site: Training site sdi-displays-trn.uk.sagex3.com, endpoint X3ERPV12 / SDIMIG (version 12), James as Super administrator. Company C01, site S01A default.
seen_on_screens.dates: Delivery line list and Order lines need a Start and End date (default about 3 months: 01/09/26 - 30/11/26). Widen the start date to catch older items.
seen_on_screens.export: Every enquiry has GLOBAL EXPORT > CSV export / Excel export in the right-hand panel.
seen_on_screens.memo: Shipments by period has Memo / Recall / Delete Memo: a saved selection, so a user can keep their own filters.
seen_on_screens.orders_menu: Sales > Enquiries > Orders holds: List of orders (CONSCSO), Order lines (CONSCSP), Orders per period, Routes, Order hitlist; also Shipments, Invoices, Returns, Allocations, Picking tickets, Parcel content, Document traceability.
